data.why: Whatnot opened its new European headquarters in Dublin three weeks ago. As CFO, Kristin has to oversee international operational expansion and the influx of regional suppliers and vendor contracts that comes with it.
data.angle: Setting up European headquarters creates a fresh stream of local supplier invoices and contracts across regional vendors that finance teams have to process.

not_chosen.reason: Bad news: Report claims Whatnot operates like a casino and is under investigation by the American justice system.
The Series G round was announced in August, making it over 90 days old and heavily covered.
Kristin joined over five months ago, and pointing out an executive's own hire date feels awkward.
Headcount growth of 35% is a broad metric rather than a specific catalyst for finance back-office work.
USPS shipping weight adjustment policy is an operational seller topic rather than an executive finance hook.

data.subject: dublin hq
data.body:
Hi Kristin,

Saw Whatnot opened a new European HQ in Dublin.

Setting up a European hub usually brings a steady wave of new regional supplier bills and contracts to review. Who on your finance team is keying and matching those today?

Mindbody processes 95%+ of invoices end to end with Zamp.

Open to seeing how?

[Your name]
